grades.measured_on_product_class: Physical test of the same product class and result, with the input varied across states and the number that moved reported.
grades.model_only: Predicted or fitted result; no physical test of that product/result.

rules.measured_link_rule: A product-class measurement is not automatically a batch link. A literature mean, an assumed CV, a model, a coupon, another product's result, or the bracket solver is never a measured link.
rules.app_rule: A calculation is allowed only for a row marked calculation.eligible and only when the user's product class and result match that row, the required measured input is present, and the output is labelled simulation.

rows.product_class: Nacre-inspired rHDPE-platelet / PDMS-matrix brick-and-mortar composite, fabricated {8,5} tensile specimen, 195 x 53 mm
rows.input_varied: rHDPE platelet modulus E_hard from 50 ASTM D638-I specimens cut from 10 plates; mean 1350 MPa, SD 239 MPa, CV 17.7%
rows.physically_measured: Uniaxial tension of 5 fabricated {8,5} composite specimens; E_eff from the initial linear stress-strain slope (CV at 0.005 strain). Feedstock modulus by tensile test; PDMS/rHDPE interface by ASTM D3163 lap shear.
rows.sample_size: composite n=5; feedstock n=50 from 10 plates; interface n=5 per plate
rows.number_that_moved: input platelet CV 18% -> measured composite E_eff CV 4%; UATSC model predicted 3% for this {8,5} case; measured sigma_max 0.22 MPa CV 13% (model 11%). The measured E_eff mean is not tabulated in text; Fig. 5 initial slope is approximately 15-17 MPa (digitised order check only).
rows.not_covered: structural products, sheet acoustics, counterweights, other polymers, delivered recyclate lot/batch variation, full 3-D/large-strain/damage prediction, creep/fatigue, a user's product
rows.locator: main text Model-Experiment Comparison; Fig. 5; SI Appendix Tables S2-S5

required: recyclate stiffness distribution: paper's measured rHDPE or user's measured mean/SD/CV, sample size and source
measured effective-modulus baseline for the actual platelet-matrix product/architecture: baseline input mean, baseline output mean, n>=3, source
numeric target range for this result
explicit selection of the PNAS {8,5} platelet-matrix product class
explicit confirmation that the product is this case, not merely the typed product name
calculation.method: baseline-anchored case-scaled simulation: E_eff_mean = baseline_output_mean * (selected_mean / baseline_input_mean); CV_eff = CV_input * (0.04/0.18); P5/P95 from a normal distribution. The paper has no measured absolute E_eff mean.
calculation.blocked_test: Measure (a) recyclate stiffness on >=3 specimens/lots with source and (b) the composite's effective modulus at a known recyclate mean, n>=3, with source; set a modulus target; select and confirm the PNAS {8,5} case.
do_not_use: any result for a product that is not the platelet-matrix composite kind
sound insulation, counterweight mass, other plastics/mixes/contamination
calculation.sanity_band_note: Digitised Fig. 5 initial slope is approximately 15-16.5 MPa; sanity check only, never used as a measured baseline.
